punchline: Pascal split the pot by what each player still needed to win.
thirty_sec: A game to three wins is stopped at two games to one, with 64 coins at stake. Pacioli's rule of shares by wins so far failed. In 1654 Pascal and Fermat argued by what can still happen: the leader is sure of 32 and shares the other 32, so 48 to 16.
question: Which shared effort in your life is divided by what is done instead of what is still ahead?
key_contrast: What a player has won matters less than what he still needs.
